# Tooltip

Tooltip: a short explanation shown on hover or focus. By default it appears after 500 ms, so it does not flash
when the pointer passes over. Icon buttons have a tooltip of their own and need no Tooltip around them. Use it
to show the full text only when the text is actually truncated.

**Interaction**: appears after hovering for 500 ms; hovering another one while a tooltip is open or has just
closed (within 300 ms) switches to it immediately. Appears immediately on keyboard focus and disappears on blur
or `Esc`; focus from a mouse click does not show it immediately.

**Category**: Basic · **Common uses**: Explaining why something is disabled, the meaning of icons or abbreviations, the full text of truncated labels

## Import

```ts
import { Tooltip } from 'vellum-ui'
```

## Basic usage

Appears after hovering for 500 ms, so it does not flash while the pointer passes over.

```tsx
export function Basic() {
  return (
    <Tooltip title="Sync the files changed in the last 24 hours">
      <Button>Incremental sync</Button>
    </Tooltip>
  )
}
```

## Advanced

### Explaining a disabled state

A disabled button does not receive mouse events, so a `span` around it receives the hover.

```tsx
export function DisabledReason() {
  return (
    <Inline>
      <Tooltip title='An administrator must grant you the "Manage projects" permission'>
        <span>
          <Button disabled>New project</Button>
        </span>
      </Tooltip>
    </Inline>
  )
}
```

## Props

No props of its own.

Also accepts the props of the corresponding Ant Design component (`TooltipProps`), except `style` and `className`.

Does not accept `style` or `className`: appearance is adjusted only through the semantic props above and the theme.
